input.command: python -c "import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt; from pathlib import Path; out=Path('out'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True); con=duckdb.connect(); df=con.execute(\"SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, SUM(COALESCE(number_of_pedestrians_killed, 0))::BIGINT AS pedestrians_killed FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet') WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year\").df(); years=pd.DataFrame({'year':range(2013,2026)}); df=years.merge(df,on='year',how='left').fillna({'pedestrians_killed':0}); df['pedestrians_killed']=df['pedestrians_killed'].astype(int); df.to_csv(out/'values_1.csv',index=False); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.8)); bars=ax.bar(df['year'].astype(str),df['pedestrians_killed'],color='#3973ac'); ax.bar_label(bars,padding=3,fontsize=9); ax.set_title('Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes by year'); ax.set_xlabel('Crash year'); ax.set_ylabel('Pedestrian deaths'); ax.set_ylim(0,df['pedestrians_killed'].max()*1.15); ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.22); ax.set_axisbelow(True); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/'option_1.png',dpi=160); print(df.to_string(index=False)); print('rows',len(df),'min',int(df.pedestrians_killed.min()),'max',int(df.pedestrians_killed.max()),'sum',int(df.pedestrians_killed.sum())); print('null_field_rows',con.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet') WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL\").fetchone()[0])"
